title: Offensive tendencies
intro: How each offense likes to play. Motion, play-action, screens, RPOs and QB out of pocket are FTN charting (2022 onward); shotgun, no-huddle and depth of target come from play-by-play. Play-action, screens and out of pocket are shares of dropbacks; the rest are shares of all plays.

columns.label: Motion
columns.note: Pre-snap motion, share of all plays (FTN, 2022+)
